issues.issue: Under the 2026-10-27 balance-sheet rule, a cash-basis report whose governmental funds statement totals match the government-wide governmental figures (528,676 on both) takes its governmental lines from the governmental funds statement, with fund balance by classification. The p1 amounts are correct, but they come from the wrong statement.

p4 swaps the Street and Police amounts compared with p2, p5 and the department schedules. The extractor recorded them per the schedules (also disbursements[2]) and noted it in report_discrepancies. That looks right, but the amounts differ from what p4 prints beside these labels.

The rules put cash held by the county treasurer under Cash and Cash Equivalents. This line is worded as an amount due, so 'due from other governments' is defensible, but it is most likely tax collections the county treasurer holds.

Under the capital outlay label rule this should read 'Capital Outlay: <function>' (e.g. Capital Outlay: Housing), with the printed text in printed_label, as was done for the Police, Street and Library capital outlay lines. The actual amount is 0.

Lines in the General and Administrative schedule were moved to other functions by label: Cemetery to health/welfare; Golf Course support 8,500, Park 656 and FEMA Rodeo Grounds 900 to culture/recreation. So the detail function totals don't tie to p2 General government 131,227. Defensible, but a judgment call.

The category matches the user decision row 'housing rehab restricted', but this receipts line lacks the category_decision and detail_category tags its detail twin (detail[10]) carries. The source of the money (possibly rehab loan repayments) isn't explained.
